status: PACKAGING STUDY WITH BENCHMARK ACTUATOR BLOCKS — NOT A FITTED, SELECTED OR LOAD-QUALIFIED DESIGN
provenance: Body numbers are the WB-8 catalog envelope (axis mapping unverified). Hip origins, offsets and link lengths are the J04-L01-S01 sketch values, kept so the model lists what that sketch collides with. Actuator block is the XL330-M288-T size/mass benchmark; it is not selected. Every bracket, plate, shaft, bearing, pulley and belt is a proposed envelope with an assumed density, not a purchased part.
units: mm, g, deg; body frame: origin at clock bottom centre, +X forward through the face, +Y left, +Z up

body.source: https://www.raycue.com/products/maclock — 80 x 91 x 112 mm, 229 g; W/D/H mapping follows Bill's screenshot
body.interior: unknown; anything inside this envelope is reported as inside-shell volume, not as a clear fit

actuator.name: XL330-M288-T size/mass benchmark block
actuator.source: https://emanual.robotis.com/docs/en/dxl/x/xl330-m288/ — Dimensions (W x H x D) 20.0 x 34.0 x 26.0 mm; Weight 18 g; read 2026-11-10
actuator.axis_offset_provenance: RECALLED from the ROBOTIS XL330 2D drawing, NOT read this sitting. Verify from XL330.pdf (https://www.robotis.com/service/download.php?no=1986) before any fit claim.
actuator.horn_provenance: proposed envelopes for the output horn and the opposite-side idler boss; not read from the drawing

hip.P1_provenance: J04-L01-S01 sketch hip origin for the front-left leg; other legs mirror the signs of X and Y
hip.offset_provenance: sketch: second hip axis 12 mm outward, no drop

links.length_provenance: J04-L01-S01 sketch: 30 + 30 mm between joint axes
links.density_provenance: assumed printed polymer for plates, webs, hubs and channels; not selected

knee.transmission_provenance: proposed GT2-class pulley and belt envelopes and a 5 mm shaft with flanged-bearing envelopes; nothing selected
knee.mount_side_note: read only by the proximal variant; the direct variant is always inline

foot.density_provenance: assumed elastomer pad; passive tilt seat not modelled

hardware_allowance_provenance: proposed allowance per joint for fasteners, spacers and output bearing; not counted parts

poses.stance_provenance: J04-L01-S01: 12 deg outward spread, 70 deg knee bend, hip swing half the knee bend in the opposite sense; front-left leg
poses.sweep_scope: viewing/search ranges, not component or controller limits
